technology_name: REMOTE POSITIONING SYSTEM FOR UNDERGROUND COAL MINES USING VISIBLE LIGHT AND LORA COMMUNICATION
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard RF tracking networks encounter signal blockage, interference, and battery limits inside deep underground coal mine tunnels, preventing safe real-time tracking of personnel.
description: A hybrid remote positioning architecture comprising an array of visible light transmitter nodes distributed along mine paths and a helmet-mounted receiver kit utilizing integrated photodiode lenses paired with an active long-range (LoRa) wireless telemetry link.
applications: Underground mine safety tracking networks, subterranean rescue logistics, tunnel construction location systems, and industrial high-security facility tracking.
secondary_sector: Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
